long_description:
Soren builds the AI workforce for business operations. We power companies around the world across a range of traditional industries, including legal, financial services, healthcare, and more.

Our specialized AI agents combine frontier intelligence with deep operational expertise to execute critical work behind the scenes, becoming an engine businesses rely on to run faster, leaner, and more effectively.

Our goal is to build the AI operating layer that the world’s businesses will run on.
name: Soren
one_liner: The AI workforce for business operations.
